set.tovw: Lead grade D: part found 1906-07, some gold still unaccounted for

cr-lemuel-hill-hoard-1906.st: In January 1907 workers emptying a granary found jars with $3,500 buried in the wheat; the paper said this was only part of his wealth and some gold was still unaccounted for.
cr-lemuel-hill-hoard-1906.t: Look around the old farmyard, granary and outbuilding sites; private: ask permission.
src: Decorah Public Opinion, 30 Jan 1907, p. 5 (from the Waukon Democrat)
